subject: clearing out the cruft: optimization, convergence

messages.subject: clearing out the cruft: optimization, convergence
parts:
revision 545:

I removed all the uncalled optimization code in
models and the optimization subdirectory of src.

By all means I'd like to put something back in
their place in the future -- just not for Stan 1.0.

revision 546:

I removed all the uncalled convergence monitoring
code, including online_avg and rhat in prob and
convergence_monitoring in mcmc.

revision 547:

oops -- fixed the top-level .hpp functions and removed
related tests.

I also moved src/stan/stan.hpp to src/stan.hpp and
removed the optimization and convergence monitoring files
from the namespace-level includes.

- Bob
